name: 大熊猫
taxon: 哺乳纲 · 食肉目 · 熊科
region: 中国西南山地（四川、陕西、甘肃）
regionEn: Mountains of SW China (Sichuan, Shaanxi, Gansu)
oneLiner: 中国旗舰物种，以竹为食，是生物多样性保护的全球象征。
oneLinerEn: China's flagship species, bamboo-feeding and a global symbol of conservation.
bio: 虽归入食肉目，却几乎完全以竹子为食；腕部籽骨特化为伪趾，便于抓握竹竿。栖息地退缩与破碎化曾使野生种群骤减，数十年的保护令其数量回升。
bioEn: Though a carnivoran, it feeds almost entirely on bamboo; an enlarged wrist bone forms a pseudo-thumb for gripping. Habitat loss once crashed wild populations, but decades of protection have recovered their numbers.

notes.v: 保护伞物种，其栖息地惠及同域众多物种
notes.vEn: Umbrella species; its habitat shelters many co-occurring species

notes.v: 由濒危降为易危，仍受栖息地破碎化威胁
notes.vEn: Downlisted to Vulnerable, still threatened by fragmentation

sources.label: 中国生物多样性红色名录

name: 银杏
taxon: 银杏纲 · 银杏目 · 银杏科
region: 中国华东（浙江天目山等地）
oneLiner: 孑遗亿年的「活化石」，是现存最古老的种子植物类群之一。
oneLinerEn: A living fossil surviving for hundreds of millions of years — among the oldest seed-plant lineages.
bio: 银杏曾广布北半球，冰期后野生种群仅残存于中国。雌雄异株，叶扇形、秋日金黄；种子（白果）可食但含微量毒素，需妥善处理。
bioEn: Once widespread across the Northern Hemisphere, wild ginkgo survived the ice ages only in China. Dioecious, with fan-shaped leaves that turn gold in autumn; its seeds are edible but mildly toxic if unprepared.

traits.vEn: Surviving lineage of an ancient group

notes.v: 野生种群极小，栽培个体基因单一
notes.vEn: Tiny wild populations; cultivars genetically narrow

notes.v: 研究演化与气候的活样本
notes.vEn: A live specimen for studying evolution and climate

sources.label: 中国珍稀濒危植物名录
sources.labelEn: China Red List of Rare and Endangered Plants

name: 水杉
region: 中国华中（湖北利川、重庆石柱）
oneLiner: 曾被认为已灭绝，20 世纪在湖北被重新发现，是植物学上的奇迹。
oneLinerEn: Thought extinct, rediscovered in Hubei in the 20th century — a botanical miracle.
bio: 水杉是落叶针叶树，与化石记录中的种类几乎一致，因而被称为「活化石」。野生植株仅存于川鄂交界狭小区域，现已广泛引种为全球行道树。
bioEn: A deciduous conifer nearly identical to its fossil relatives, hence a 'living fossil'. Wild trees survive only in a tiny Sichuan–Hubei border zone, yet it is now planted worldwide as an ornamental.

traits.v: 针叶树中少见的落叶习性
traits.vEn: Unusual among conifers for losing leaves

notes.v: 野生种群极小，需就地保护
notes.vEn: Tiny wild population needs in-situ protection

notes.v: 连通化石与现生的关键证据
notes.vEn: Key link between fossils and living flora

sources.label: 中国珍稀濒危植物名录
sources.labelEn: China Red List of Rare and Endangered Plants

name: 朱鹮
region: 中国中部（陕西洋县等地）
oneLiner: 曾仅存 7 只，经人工繁育与栖息地保护，成为濒危物种恢复的典范。
oneLinerEn: Down to just 7 birds, then recovered through captive breeding — a model of endangered-species revival.
bio: 朱鹮体白羽橙、面部绯红，栖息于稻田与湿地，觅食小鱼、泥鳅与蛙。20 世纪 80 年代在陕西重新发现后，建立保护站与人工种群，数量显著回升。
bioEn: White-plumaged with orange cheeks, it forages fish and frogs in rice paddies and wetlands. Rediscovered in Shaanxi in the 1980s, protected stations and captive breeding brought numbers back.

traits.vEn: Relies on paddies and wetlands for food
Few eggs per clutch, slow recovery

notes.v: 就地保护 + 人工繁育双轨成功
notes.vEn: In-situ protection plus captive breeding succeeded

notes.v: 种群回升但仍脆弱
notes.vEn: Recovered but still fragile

sources.label: 中国生物多样性红色名录

name: 白头叶猴
oneLiner: 全球仅分布于广西喀斯特石山的狭域特有灵长类。
oneLinerEn: A narrowly endemic primate found only in the karst hills of Guangxi.
bio: 通体黑毛、头顶与尾端雪白，栖于陡峭石灰岩峰丛，以树叶为食。分布区极窄，种群规模小，是灵长类中最濒危的类群之一。
bioEn: Black-bodied with a white crown and tail-tip, it lives on steep limestone peaks, eating leaves. Its range is tiny and its population small, among the most endangered primates.

traits.v: 仅存于广西一小片喀斯特
traits.vEn: Survives only in a small Guangxi karst area

notes.v: 喀斯特生态系统健康指示种
notes.vEn: Indicator of karst ecosystem health

notes.v: 保护区建立后趋稳
notes.vEn: Stabilized after reserves established

sources.label: 中国生物多样性红色名录

name: 扬子鳄
region: 中国长江中下游（安徽、浙江）
oneLiner: 中国特有的小型短吻鳄，是世界上最濒危的鳄类之一。
oneLinerEn: China's endemic small alligator — among the world's most endangered crocodilians.
bio: 与美洲短吻鳄近缘，体型较小、吻短，穴居于水边。野生数量曾极度稀少，经人工繁育放归，野外种群开始恢复。
bioEn: Closely related to the American alligator but smaller with a short snout, it burrows along waterways. Wild numbers were once tiny; captive breeding and releases are restoring wild populations.

notes.v: 人工繁育放归成效显著
notes.vEn: Captive breeding and release show clear success

notes.v: 野外仍稀少，依赖持续放归
notes.vEn: Still rare in the wild, reliant on releases

sources.label: 中国生物多样性红色名录

name: 藏羚羊
region: 中国青藏高原（羌塘、可可西里）
oneLiner: 高原迁徙有蹄类，曾因绒被盗猎几近崩溃，如今显著恢复。
oneLinerEn: A plateau migrant once devastated by poaching for its wool, now substantially recovered.
bio: 雄性具细长黑角，每年成群长途迁徙至产羔地。藏羚绒极细软，曾遭大量盗猎；设立保护区与打击偷猎后种群回升，保护级别下调。
bioEn: Males bear long black horns and migrate en masse to calving grounds. Its ultrafine wool drove massive poaching; reserves and anti-poaching lifted numbers, lowering its threat rank.

traits.vEn: Seasonal round trips to calving sites

notes.v: 反盗猎 + 保护区令种群回升
notes.vEn: Anti-poaching and reserves rebuilt populations

notes.v: 由濒危降为近危
notes.vEn: Downlisted from Endangered to Near Threatened

sources.label: 中国生物多样性红色名录

name: 中华鲟
regionEn: Yangtze River and adjacent seas, China
oneLiner: 江海洄游的「活化石」大鱼，因大坝与航运几近失去自然繁殖。
oneLinerEn: An anadromous 'living fossil' giant, nearly losing natural reproduction to dams and shipping.
bio: 中华鲟溯江产卵、海中成长，寿命可达数十年。葛洲坝等工程阻断洄游通道后自然繁殖急剧下降，现依赖人工增殖放流维系种群。
bioEn: It spawns upstream and grows at sea, living decades. Dams like Gezhouba blocked its migration, collapsing wild reproduction; hatchery releases now sustain the population.

traits.vEn: Feeds at sea, spawns in rivers

traits.v: 与恐龙同代的古老鱼类

notes.v: 长江生态健康的旗舰指示
notes.vEn: Flagship indicator of Yangtze ecosystem health

notes.v: 自然繁殖近乎中断，靠放流维持
notes.vEn: Wild spawning nearly halted; sustained by release

sources.label: 中国生物多样性红色名录

name: 白鱀豚
taxon: 哺乳纲 · 鲸偶蹄目 · 白鱀豚科
oneLiner: 长江特有的「水中女神」，2006 年科考难觅踪影，被视为功能性灭绝的首个大型水生哺乳动物。
oneLinerEn: The Yangtze's 'goddess'; a 2006 survey found none—taken as the first large aquatic mammal functionally extinct.
bio: 白鱀豚在长江演化了逾两千万年，以声呐捕食鱼类，性情羞怯。航运噪声、螺旋桨、误捕与水质恶化令其种群崩溃，2007 年被评估为功能性灭绝，堪称长江生态之殇。
bioEn: The baiji evolved in the Yangtze over 20 million years, hunting fish by sonar, shy by nature. Ship noise, propellers, bycatch and pollution collapsed it; declared functionally extinct in 2007—the river's great wound.

traits.v: 以回波定位鱼群，视力高度退化
仅分布于长江，演化史逾两千万年

notes.v: 种群过小而难再繁衍，虽或有残存个体
notes.vEn: Population too small to recover, though stragglers may remain

notes.v: 首个因人类活动功能性灭绝的大型水生哺乳动物
notes.vEn: First large aquatic mammal driven to functional extinction by people

name: 华南虎
taxon: 哺乳纲 · 食肉目 · 猫科
region: 中国华南（野生几近消失）
oneLiner: 中国独有的虎亚种，野外已数十年未见确证踪迹，仅存于圈养种群。
oneLinerEn: A tiger subspecies unique to China; no confirmed wild trace for decades, surviving only in captivity.
bio: 华南虎体型较小、斑纹宽疏，曾广布华中与华南山地。因猎杀与栖息地丧失，野生种群于上世纪末基本消失，现存数百只圈养个体面临近亲繁殖挑战，重引入仍在规划。
bioEn: Smaller and more sparsely striped, it once ranged over central-south China. Hunting and habitat loss wiped out wild populations by the late 20th century; hundreds in captivity now face inbreeding, reintroduction still planned.

traits.v: 虎的华南亚种，形态独特
数十年无确证的野外记录
traits.vEn: No confirmed wild record for decades

notes.v: 谱系管理艰难，近交威胁遗传多样性
notes.vEn: Studbook strain; inbreeding threatens diversity

notes.v: 海外繁育基地正探索回归野外的可能
notes.vEn: Overseas breeding bases explore return to wild

sources.label: 中国生物多样性红色名录

name: 绿孔雀
taxon: 鸟纲 · 鸡形目 · 雉科
oneLiner: 中国本土唯一的孔雀，远比常见的蓝孔雀珍稀，栖息于云南的河谷季雨林。
oneLinerEn: China's only native peafowl, far rarer than the familiar blue peafowl, dwelling in Yunnan's valley forests.
bio: 绿孔雀雄鸟翠蓝泛金，求偶开屏炫耀。因开垦、水电与旅游开发蚕食季雨林，加上偷猎，中国野外种群仅存数百只；而园林中常见的「孔雀」多为引进的蓝孔雀，常被混淆。
bioEn: The male gleams blue-green with gold, fanning in courtship. Farming, hydropower and tourism have eaten its monsoon-forest home, plus poaching, leaving a few hundred wild in China; the common garden 'peacock' is usually the introduced blue peafowl, easily confused.

traits.v: 中国原产的唯一孔雀属物种
雄鸟展尾屏以争夺配偶
traits.vEn: Male fans its train to win mates

notes.v: 公园蓝孔雀非本土，易张冠李戴
notes.vEn: Park blue peafowls are not native

notes.v: 季雨林破碎化是首要威胁
notes.vEn: Fragmented monsoon forest is the top threat

sources.label: 中国生物多样性红色名录

name: 珙桐
taxon: 被子植物 · 山茱萸目 · 蓝果树科
oneLiner: 开花如白鸽群栖的「中国鸽子树」，第四纪冰川中侥幸幸存的孑遗植物。
oneLinerEn: The 'dove tree' whose white bracts perch like pigeons—a relict that slipped through the Quaternary glaciers.
bio: 珙桐的头状花序配两片白色大苞片，远望若群鸽落枝，故西人称之为鸽子树。它是第三纪孑遗，靠冰川期在东亚山地寻得避难所才延续至今，现因栖息地狭窄而受保护。
bioEn: Its flower heads carry two large white bracts, seen afar as doves on branches—hence the Western name. A Tertiary relict, it survived the ice ages in East Asian mountain refuges; its narrow range keeps it under protection.

traits.v: 两片白苞似鸽翼，花序如鸽身
traits.vEn: White bracts like wings, the head like a body

traits.v: 冰川前的古类群，东亚避难所幸存
traits.vEn: Pre-glacial lineage saved in East Asian refugia

notes.v: 与银杏同属孑遗类群
notes.vEn: A relict like the ginkgo

notes.v: 著名观赏树，多国引种栽培
notes.vEn: Famed ornamental, introduced worldwide
